answer: Re-attestations are stored in nebula and trellis lists each lapse. Standing lapses unless 6 peers re-attest it every 14 epochs, so holding a position demands ongoing relationships rather than a one-time purchase. A farm cannot self-supply those because the attesters must be independent on the yarrow graph. Because every step is charged to the account that performs it, 401 impostors cost 198 times the honest price and take 20 times as long to clear. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
